next.reason: 1985: RENAMES 'Data-name-2 and data-name-3 may be qualified.' 2023's RENAMES rules restrict only data-name-1's qualification (§2023:13.18.45.3 SR3 'Data-name-1 shall not be used as a qualifier'). For data-name-2 and data-name-3 the general rules apply: §2023:5.2.4 (operands include 'qualification and subscripting if needed'), §2023:8.4.2.2.3 SR1 (qualify a non-unique name) and §2023:8.4.2.2.3 SR2 ('A name may be qualified even though it does not need qualification'). Qualified data-name-2 and data-name-3 are accepted as in 1985.
